articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI support bot got socially engineered harder than a freshman at DEFCON, letting attackers seize the Obama White House Instagram account. When your AI assistant falls for the same tricks as your grandma, maybe it's time to rethink automation.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually leaked AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like dropping state secrets in a coffee shop. Congress is now demanding answers while CISA tries to explain how the cybersecurity agency became the cybersecurity cautionary tale.

articles.title: Welcome New EFF Executive Director Nicole Ozer
articles.summary: A CISA contractor turned GitHub into their personal cloud storage for AWS GovCloud credentials and internal secrets. The irony of America's cybersecurity watchdog getting pwned by basic OPSEC failures is so thick you could cut it with a rusty exploit.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: Police are using license plate readers for everything from truancy enforcement to noise complaints because mission creep is the real pandemic. EFF's data dive reveals cops treating ALPR databases like their personal stalking toolkit.

articles.title: Anthropic to Open Mythos AI to EU's ENISA
articles.summary: EFF scores a win for encrypted messaging while the surveillance state sharpens its knives. End-to-end encryption remains our digital armor against prying eyes, assuming you can keep the backdoor enthusiasts at bay.

articles.title: Patch Now: Another Palo Alto Auth Bypass Bug Under Active Exploit
articles.summary: Microsoft threatens legal action against researcher who published zero-days, because apparently shooting the messenger is the new responsible disclosure. Nothing says 'we take security seriously' like criminalizing the people who find your bugs.

articles.title: New York Comptroller’s Trip to Israel Raised Ethical Concerns, State Commission Said
articles.summary: Philadelphia police openly admit to tracking 'First Amendment activity' critical of AI data centers. Apparently exercising constitutional rights while questioning our robot overlords is now considered suspicious behavior worth surveillance.

articles.title: Password manager Dashlane suspends customer accounts amid brute-force attacks
articles.summary: Palo Alto's VPN authentication bypass bug graduated from theoretical to actively exploited faster than a script kiddie finding metasploit. Emergency patch Tuesday strikes again for PAN-OS users living in perpetual update hell.

articles.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: New Linux Flaw, PAN-OS Exploit, AI-Powered Attacks, OAuth Phishing and More
articles.summary: Supply chain attack compromises Red Hat npm packages with credential-stealing worm that propagates like digital herpes. The Miasma campaign proves that trusting your package manager is about as smart as trusting a Nigerian prince.

articles.summary: Pwn2Own Berlin delivered 47 zero-days and over $1.2 million in payouts, proving that breaking things responsibly is still the most profitable hobby. TrendAI's AI-focused competition shows even our robot friends aren't immune to good old-fashioned exploitation.
